subject.title: [Bug] OpenClaw UI WebSocket reconnect 导致会话 terminated

question: Should the remaining Control UI reconnect active-run preservation be handled by a current-main replacement, by reviving https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/41067, or by declaring the existing Stop/send mitigations sufficient?
rationale: Current main has partial mitigations and a server-side recovery payload, but the direct PR is stale, conflicting, and proof-gated; choosing the durable UI/Gateway reconnect contract is a maintainer ownership decision before more repair work is queued.

options.title: Open a current-main replacement
options.body: Implement the remaining webchat active-run adoption against the current `ui/src/pages/chat` and `packages/gateway-protocol` surfaces, preserving useful attribution from the open PR where appropriate.

options.title: Revive the open PR
options.body: Ask the contributor or an adopter to rebase the existing PR, move protocol changes to the live package, fix review findings, and add real reconnect proof.

options.title: Accept partial mitigation
options.body: Explicitly decide that Stop visibility and send retry are sufficient, then narrow or close the remaining reports with that product rationale.

recommendation.title: Open a current-main replacement
recommendation.body: Implement the remaining webchat active-run adoption against the current `ui/src/pages/chat` and `packages/gateway-protocol` surfaces, preserving useful attribution from the open PR where appropriate.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev authored the closest merged reconnect mitigations and is the strongest available history signal for the remaining Control UI/WebChat recovery contract.
